sources.title: On the Measure of Intelligence
sources.use: Skill acquisition, priors and experience should be measured separately from trained task scores.

sources.title: Levels of AGI
sources.use: Separate breadth, depth and autonomy in the operational rubric.

sources.title: Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Software Tasks
sources.use: Measure completion horizons and their uncertainty; software results alone do not establish generality.

sources.title: DreamCoder
sources.use: Treat reusable program libraries and learned proposal policies as testable mechanisms.

sources.title: Towards Causal Representation Learning
sources.use: Test causal representations through interventions and transfer, not association alone.

scope: References support design choices; the 160-stage roadmap and its priority are the assistant's synthesis, not a proven AGI recipe.
